text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Full of nutrition! Full of justice! 
Carotene charge, Carrotman! —Transform! 
Sapid Form!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!? You're amazing! What the heck is 
that!?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, pretty cool, huh! It's Carrotman's 
brand-new transformation item!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... How could I let this 
happen...! I had no idea something like 
this even existed!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like it just came out! They were 
selling tons of other new stuff too, like 
weapons and mufflers!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What was that—!? No time to waste! 
Straight to the toy store we go!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hellooo! Do you have any Carrot Man toys!?

text_block_list.name: Toy Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... The new batch has already sold 
out. It's incredibly popular, you see.

text_block_list.name: Toy Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
The toy store in the next town over is 
bigger than this one, so they might still 
have some in stock, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The next town over! I know that place! All 
right, let's head over right—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...B-But still! I absolutely don't want it 
to sell out again while we're doing that! 
So—woooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Biko Pegasus ended up wandering 
from toy store to toy store, skipping out 
on training.
